name: hcapp_getRunEmailContext
description: Everything the API needs to draft or send a run email (E9.F6.S6-S9; E19). Called by the RunEmail API endpoint on behalf of the app with the app's own device token (procName = this SP). Gate: the caller must be allowed to create/edit runs for the kennel — HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'createEditRuns' with the hare-of-this-run exemption, the same gate as hcapp_addEditEvent; anyone who may save the run may send it. The context, history and send list are built in ONE place, HC6.nonApi_runEmailContext, shared with the portal (hcportal_getRunEmailContext). Send-list rule (James, 2026-10-09): opt-in (member / follower / RSVP Yes-Maybe / run alert explicitly on) and no opt-out (run alert 2 beats all; kennel alert 2; EmailBlocked; bouncing; removed; no address). Addresses are returned only to a kennel run admin (the same permission WITHOUT the hare exemption, callerMaySeeEmails) — never to a hare who may edit just this run (James, 2026-10-10). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 151, @param NULL).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run. NULL or zero UUID: errorCode 1510, errorType 2. No live run (deleted = 0, removed = 0): 1511, errorType 3.

parameters.name: includeRecipients
parameters.description: 0 = context and history only; 1 = also the Recipients rowset; 2 = also the NonRecipients rowset (the audience page, 'who gets it' and who does not, with the reason). Default 0.

rowsets.description: On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth), missing run (1510/2), run not found (1511/3) or not authorised (1512/13): the error detail alone, no envelope. All three local checks are logged with the event (and kennel) id. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (THROW).

rowsets.name: RunContext
rowsets.description: Exactly one row: the run, its kennel and the sender (HC6.nonApi_runEmailContext rowset 0).

columns.name: publicEventId
columns.description: HC.Event.PublicEventId, lower-cased text — for the run's web link.

columns.name: senderEmail
columns.description: The caller's HC.Hasher.Email (may be generated — HC6.IsGeneratedEmail).

columns.name: instruction
columns.description: HC.Kennel.RunEmailInstruction — the kennel's saved drafting instruction for the assistant.

rowsets.name: History
rowsets.description: Exactly one row: what has been sent for this run and how many would get the next one.

columns.name: emailSendCount
columns.description: HC.Event.EmailSendCount — emails sent for this run so far.

columns.name: emailLastSentCount
columns.description: HC.Event.EmailLastSentCount — recipients of the last send.

columns.name: recipientCount
columns.description: How many hashers the send list holds now.

columns.name: callerMaySeeEmails
columns.description: 1 when the caller holds createEditRuns on the kennel WITHOUT the hare exemption — the recipient rowsets then carry addresses; 0 for a hare who may edit only this run.

rowsets.name: Recipients
rowsets.description: Only when @includeRecipients >= 1: the send list, ORDER BY LOWER(hashName).

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: The hasher's hash name (same value as hashName; kept for older clients).

columns.name: reasonCode
columns.description: Why they get it: 1 run emails on, 2 kennel emails on, 9 member, 10 follower, 11 RSVP'd.

columns.name: canMove
columns.description: 1 when an admin may override the choice for one send (never for 6, 7, 8).

rowsets.name: NonRecipients
rowsets.description: Only when @includeRecipients = 2: the kennel's members who will NOT get it and why, same columns as Recipients, ORDER BY LOWER(hashName). reasonCode: 3 run emails off, 4 kennel emails off, 5 not a member, follower or RSVP, 6 no email address, 7 blocked all emails, 8 email bouncing.

columns.name: canMove
columns.description: 1 when an admin may add them for one send; 0 for 6, 7, 8.

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.CheckKennelPermission twice ('createEditRuns' with @isHareOfEvent for the gate, lines 114-115; without it for callerMaySeeEmails, lines 132-133)
EXEC HC6.nonApi_runEmailContext (@eventId, @userId, @includeRecipients, @callerMaySeeEmails) — produces every success rowset, line 134
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1510 / 1511 / 1512 (lines 89-90, 104-105, 119-120) and from the CATCH block (lines 138-140, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: Lines 32 and 44-45 describe only '1 = also return the recipient rowset', but HC6.nonApi_runEmailContext also honours 2 (the non-recipients rowset, rowset 3), and this SP passes the value through. The portal twin and the audience page rely on 2.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
